parameters.name: ActionOnMaintenance
parameters.description:
The maintenance action. Valid values:

*   Stop: stops the instance.
*   AutoRecover: automatically recovers the instance.
*   AutoRedeploy: redeploys the instance, which may damage the data disks attached to the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of instance N. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NotifyOnMaintenance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to send an event notification before maintenance. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-instance-maintenance-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --action-on-maintenance AutoRecover --notify-on-maintenance false --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --maintenance-window EndTime=18:00:00 StartTime=02:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyInstanceMaintenanceAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --MaintenanceWindow.1.EndTime '18:00:00' --MaintenanceWindow.1.StartTime '02:00:00' --ActionOnMaintenance AutoRecover --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceId.1 'i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --NotifyOnMaintenance false
